glossEn: financial assistance in time of need
note: financial assistance in time of need。现有中文无此义项，属新增 —— 这是社会保障语境：unemployment benefit / welfare benefit。与 s2 分界：s2 是泛指「好处」，本条专指「发给人的钱」。

glossEn: something that aids or promotes well-being
note: something that aids or promotes well-being。线索：for the benefit of / to one's benefit。最常用的名词义。

glossEn: a performance to raise money for a charitable cause
note: a performance to raise money for a charitable cause。现有中文无此义项，属新增。线索：a benefit concert / benefit show/gala。唯一必须带表演语境才成立的义项。
be beneficial for。线索：benefit from / sth benefits sb。可及物（benefit sb）也可不及物（benefit from sth），两种中文译法指同一条释义。
